EEG is bandpass filtered (1-45 Hz) and cleaned using Artifact Subspace Reconstruction. Data is segmented into 10-second epochs with 50% overlap. For each epoch, spectral coherence, Phase Lag Index (PLI), and weighted Phase Lag Index (wPLI) are calculated between all channel pairs in delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands. Graph theoretical measures including clustering coefficient, path length, and small-worldness are computed from thresholded networks. Time-varying network properties are tracked across successive windows and correlated with behavioral measures.
